# Repository-only executables are verified by their dedicated unit, process,
# packaging, checksum, signature, and system tests. Standard `go test`
# coverprofiles cannot attribute subprocess execution back to these binaries.
# Each exclusion has an explicit review date and must not be extended silently.
internal/tools/	2027-01-31	Repository-only fixtures and release tooling use dedicated process and package gates; they are not shipped production processes.
packaging/agent/testdata/	2027-01-31	Fake Agent source is a packaging fixture exercised as a built subprocess; it is never shipped as a production process.
cmd/server/main.go	2027-01-31	Composition root is covered by build, startup, lifecycle, and HTTP integration gates.
cmd/build-worker/main.go	2027-01-31	Composition root is covered by build-worker lifecycle and process integration gates.
cmd/evidence-worker/main.go	2027-01-31	Composition root is covered by evidence-worker lifecycle and OCI integration gates.
cmd/agent/main.go	2027-01-31	Composition root is covered by real Agent control, enrollment, rotation, dual-host, and systemd process gates.
cmd/agent/enroll.go	2027-01-31	Enrollment CLI binding is covered by command tests and the real root-path enrollment process gate; domain logic remains measured.
